methodological_eligibility.evidence_quote: The paper proposes a new concept of using of Mathematical Model Benchmarking (MMB).  The unitless indicator i.e. Benchmark Energy Factor (BEF) overcomes the current barriers.

paper_type.evidence_quote: The exercise of obtaining the BEF Range was performed for over 25 IRS’s. The outcome of this activity was a range of BEF (average annual) values assigned to every facility of the same category.

enpi_enb_model_types.evidence_quote: The Ideal Energy can be calculated very accurately by using well known laws of physics chosen as a function of the work type performed by the end-use equipment [1], [11]. A mathematical model incorporating all the independent parameters and automatically normalize for any variability is used to determine the Ideal Energy, eliminating the tedious normalization process.
